title: ~~Undocumented build from `oci-archive` url?~~ <irrelevant to podman>
body:
To my amazement, the solution suggested in [this message](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/18217#issuecomment-1510398652) just works:
```shell
$ apptainer build image.sif oci-archive://image.tar
```
But it is.. undocumented [here](https://apptainer.org/docs/user/main/build_a_container.html) or [there](https://apptainer.org/docs/user/main/cli/apptainer_build.html#apptainer-build)?

(btw could it feed from stdin instead to avoid relying on intermediate disk file?)

comments.body: We have noting to do with apptainer
